goal: Select one EN-to-VI Core MT and one VI-to-EN Core MT for later compact deployment research. This phase does not claim that a teacher runs on the target weak device.

locked_final_evaluation.access_rule: Open exactly once only after the Core MT decision for both directions is written and frozen. Final results cannot change the selected Core MT.

workflow: Run each pretrained candidate on IT Validation and General Validation in both directions.
Record the candidate(s) retained for IT adaptation and the evidence-based reason; do not use an invented threshold or weighted score.
Adapt only retained candidate(s) using IT Train. The human-approved experiment record declares either full fine-tuning or LoRA before training.
Evaluate adapted checkpoints on IT Validation and General Validation.
Review the pre-sealed IT Validation sample for adapted candidate(s). Record translation_error and technical_error only.
Freeze one Core MT per direction from the complete validation and review evidence.
Run the frozen Core MT once on IT Test and General Test for final reporting; do not reopen selection.

evidence_contract.pretrained: evidence/phase02/<model>/<direction>/pretrained/<dataset_role>/{predictions.jsonl,metrics.json,run.json}; run.json records documented checkpoint runtime controls and output normalization when required.
evidence_contract.adaptation_feasibility: docs/phase_02/lora_hardware_feasibility.md records the fixed-hardware preflight used to choose a feasible adaptation method; it contains no translation-quality result and does not replace an experiment record.
evidence_contract.adaptation_training: evidence/phase02/<model>/<direction>/adapted/<experiment_id>/{experiment_record.md,training_run.json}; checkpoint files are stored outside evidence at models/phase02/<experiment_id>/<checkpoint_id>/.
evidence_contract.adapted_evaluation: evidence/phase02/<model>/<direction>/adapted/<experiment_id>/<checkpoint_id>/<dataset_role>/{predictions.jsonl,metrics.json,run.json}; each evaluated checkpoint has one completed directory for selection_validation and one for general_validation.
evidence_contract.write_rule: A completed evidence directory is immutable. A failed run remains in a sibling .running directory and is never used as evidence.

evaluation.technical_analysis: Use existing technical_tags only for descriptive breakdowns when the sample has enough cases. Do not create a composite technical score.
evaluation.manual_review: Use one IT Validation sample sealed before any predictions are inspected. Record only translation_error and technical_error as yes/no/unclear.
evaluation.general_validation: Report pretrained and adapted results separately as an outside-domain guardrail. It is not an optimization target and has no invented pass threshold.
evaluation.selection: Choose separately for EN-to-VI and VI-to-EN from the recorded evidence. Do not average directions or use a weighted composite score.
evaluation.final_evaluation: IT Test and General Test are reporting-only data. Their outputs are not selection evidence.

checkpoint_runtime_controls: Use the checkpoint GenerationConfig by default. A model-card runtime control may be used only when the official checkpoint documentation states it, it is stored in phase02_models.json with its source, and run.json records the applied value. Removing a documented leading language-control output prefix before scoring is output normalization, not rewriting translation content.
input_length_handling: When a source exceeds a checkpoint's documented input-token limit, the runner uses deterministic whitespace segmentation and character-boundary fallback, translates every segment with the documented checkpoint runtime controls, and joins segment outputs. It records the limit and segmented-row counts. This preserves source text and is not generation tuning.
adaptation_method: For a retained candidate, use either full fine-tuning or one declared LoRA configuration. The method, precision and every LoRA setting are recorded before training. A GPU preflight may only establish hardware feasibility from IT Train; it does not use translation quality to select a configuration.
prohibited: training on validation or final-evaluation data
using IT Test or General Test before the Core MT decision is frozen
changing the Core MT decision after final evaluation
composite scores, invented thresholds, LLM-as-a-judge, or new technical taxonomies
generative AI for rewriting, synthetic data, judging, ranking, or automatic data repair
notebook code that writes predictions, metrics, review decisions, selection records, or final results
